runs.name: Hyatt Hotels Corporation; NYSE H; a global hotel manager, franchisor and owner with all-inclusive resorts and a distribution arm; Playa bought 2025; Marriott and Hilton read
runs.entry: Price **$162.92** (close 2026-10-13; aggregator quote printed by `tools/run.py`, flagged). Shares **94,236,736**, Class A 41,600,929 and Class B 52,635,807, economically equal (Class B ten votes; same earnings per share and dividend) (10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30, filed 2026-07-30, accession 0001468174-26-000025, cover; `cover_shares.py`; checked against 94,281,114 issued and outstanding at 2026-06-30, repurchased Class A retired; nothing filed after the 10-Q); cap **$15,353M**. Sovereign **5.56%** (US Treasury daily par yield curve, 30-year, 2026-10-13). Filings read: 10-K FY2025 (0001468174-26-000007), 10-Q Q2 2026, DEF 14A filed 2026-04-02 (0001104659-26-038759), the 10-Ks FY2019 to FY2024 for the span, the 8-Ks of 2026; figures cross-checked (FY2025 operating cash $379M on the filed statement against the tool's figure; total debt $4,278M in the MD&A against the balance sheet). Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7 (the brief's departure), eight stated in the run file. Rivals: the 10-K names no hotel rival by company (the dispatcher's reading confirmed); Marriott and Hilton chosen as a CONVENTION of the run, Airbnb read as the named substitute that files; Alibaba, Google, Vrbo, Vacasa and Trip.com flagged, not compared. **Q1 IN**: management and franchising decides at 64% of 2021 to 2025 segment Adjusted EBITDA ($3,376M of $5,238M; the filer's only segment profit measure, used to apportion only, a CONVENTION of the run); key variables rooms, fee rates, RevPAR, key money and loyalty, reported yearly, contracts 12 to 20 years. **Q2 IN, narrowly**: for, 63M loyalty members, member stays 47% to 49% of room nights, long contracts, rooms 8.9% a year 2019 to 2025, a field whose leaders turn fees into owner cash at 44% (Marriott) and 51% (Hilton); against, Hyatt the smallest of three systems, key money 12.8% of fees 2023 to 2025 against 6.5% and 5.9%, contra revenue 3.6% to 7.2% of fees, owner cash 7% of fees in 2025; distribution (ALG, Mr & Mrs Smith) open, $176M of $210M goodwill impaired, carried at no growth with the owned hotels. **Q3 WEIGHS AGAINST**: high return on about $1.4B of tangible capital, but $5,148M paid for businesses 2021 to 2025 while owner cash fell ($559M in 2022 to $240M in 2025). **Q4 no STOP, WEIGHS AGAINST**: balance sheets 2018 to 2025 read (eight year-ends); they reconcile, controls effective, no restatement; Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted Free Cash Flow and guidance featured; goodwill and intangibles $0.9B to $5.7B, tangible equity +$2.8B to -$2.3B, debt $1.6B to $4.3B. **Q5 integrity IN** (the adjusted-figure habit against; Thomas Pritzker's immediate retirement as Executive Chairman on 2026-02-16 unexplained, recorded); **ability WEIGHS AGAINST narrowly** (capital allocated 2021 to 2025 has not earned its cost). **Q6 WEIGHS AGAINST on both parts**: Part A, $4,460M of hotel and business sales and new debt into purchases, and $2,305M of buybacks 2022 to 2025 at $143 to about $163 with no stated price, above the top of every range; every deal paid in cash, so the all-stock STOP does not apply; Part B, pay on Adjusted Compensation EBITDA with no capital charge, SARs without a step-up, total-return awards, the CEO also Chairman since 2026-02-16. Owner cash (operating cash less stock pay and capital spending; all-equity before interest) 315 / 559 / 540 / 420 / 240 ($M, 2021 to 2025), mean **$414.6M**; equity-only mean $281.6M; 2021 aberrational (a $254M IRS refund), the window without it $439.7M beside; the decline carried as the bottom (-6.6% a year end to end); net purchases $688M fall $16M short of the serial-acquirer test on the equity-only series, so the default pair is central, the organic pair (owner cash before purchases and deal items, $504.8M, at 6.7% rooms growth excluding acquisitions) beside; maintenance guess not available from the filing; net debt $3,675M. **Q7 OUT**: central, default pair, all-equity **-$2.68 to $40.14** a share (equity-only $21.14 to $53.74), organic pair **$57.35 to $125.14** beside, against **$162.92**; no case earns the floor (highest value at ten percent $45.99, the organic top; a stress case built by no convention $125.20); the price needs about $1.9B a year of owner cash before interest, 4.6 times the window mean. Fair central all-equity **-$7.19**, not positive (equity-only $20.16); alert on the organic pair, **$30.28** all-equity, $51.02 equity-only. Facts after the stop, not weighed: senior notes $4,239M due 2027 to 2035, $605M due within a year at 2026-06-30, interest paid $277M in 2025 against all-equity owner cash of $240M, revolver $1.5B undrawn, owner guarantees and venture commitments listed; Q12: casinos at managed hotels run by third parties. Contamination declared by the analyst: a `Test Runs/` listing filtered to today's date, made to check its own file did not exist, showed other 2026-10-14 run file names (CHH, HGV, HLT, MAR, OUTKY, SSAAY, SZGPY, TKAMY, WH), none opened (a blind-rule breach, declared); the HGV fold commit subjects and memory-index lines in its session context, not used. Commits b909a86a, 9b941b61, 3cfc9c95, 7777d300, 4c6b2149, 041da282, f411af92, 1b6a4e09, e80d85ff (a commit per question; write-early partly breached, declared: all reading done before Step 0 was written). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's check clean (79 ids, 45 fragments); the dispatcher's `_dispatcher_cite_check.py` 79 ids, 42 quoted cites, no missing id, no E-id, no slip. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) the serial-acquirer test and disposals: whether hotel sales with contracts kept are businesses sold, whether a finished disposal programme may net a standing purchase policy, and which owner-cash series the half is taken of ($688M net against $704M equity-only; gross $5,148M seven times over); (2) whether purchases are charged in the no-growth top of a declining default pair; (3) specific (a) with one trough and a changed business before it; (4) organic growth reported only as one year of rooms growth; (5) deal taxes and costs inside operating cash while prices sit in investing; (6) the parts threshold on operating profit when the filer reports only segment Adjusted EBITDA. Could not get: organic owner-cash growth, the maintenance and renewal splits of capex and key money, Playa term-loan interest, deal costs before 2023, a completed cycle.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7 after Q1 IN (management and franchising decides at 64% of 2021 to 2025 segment Adjusted EBITDA), Q2 IN narrowly (63M loyalty members, member stays 47% to 49% of nights, 12 to 20 year contracts, rooms 8.9% a year 2019 to 2025; against, the smallest of three systems, key money 12.8% of fees against Marriott 6.5% and Hilton 5.9%, owner cash 7% of fees against 44% and 51% in 2025; distribution open, $176M of $210M goodwill impaired), Q3 against ($5.1B of purchases 2021 to 2025 while owner cash fell from $559M to $240M), Q4 no STOP with adjusted figures and tangible equity +$2.8B to -$2.3B against, Q5 integrity IN with ability against narrowly (the Executive Chairman's immediate retirement unexplained), Q6 against on both parts (hotel proceeds and debt into purchases and $2.3B of unpriced buybacks at $143 to $163; pay on EBITDA, SARs, CEO also Chairman). Owner cash $414.6M all-equity mean 2021 to 2025, declining; default pair central (net purchases $16M short of the serial-acquirer test), organic pair beside; net debt $3,675M. Value -$2.68 to $40.14 central, $57.35 to $125.14 organic, against $162.92 at the 5.56% Treasury, no case earning the floor; central fair -$7.19, alert on the organic pair $30.28 all-equity ($51.02 equity-only), armed. Framework gaps for the operator: disposals in the serial-acquirer test; purchases in a declining no-growth top; one trough; organic growth as rooms; deal items inside operating cash; parts on segment Adjusted EBITDA.
